meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth - startup tips, working tips, and any Tip: line shown in the TUI (including the Fable-5-refusal fallback tip). Use when the user asks about a Tip: line, says give-me-tips, asks what a tip means, how a tipped feature works, or which tips they can see. Queries the live tip list (senpi --list-tips) first, checks what THIS user can actually see, then verifies the real feature code before explaining.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入解释任何senpi提示的含义与用法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用senpi时想弄懂每条提示在说什么
copy.tagline_en: Explain any senpi tip in depth
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand what each senpi tip means and how to use it

howto.what: 用户询问 senpi 提示时，Claude 先运行 `senpi --list-tips` 获取实时提示列表，读取该用户设置，确认其实际可见的提示；再阅读功能代码核实行为，最后用用户提问的语言深入解释，注明文件路径。
howto.when: 当用户说“give-me-tips”、问某条“Tip:”行是什么意思、或询问某个提示功能的原理时触发。

say.text: 解释一下刚才那条 Tip: 行到底是什么意思？
say.note: 会先查提示列表和代码再回答。

say.text: give-me-tips，启动提示里的这个技巧具体怎么工作的？
say.note: 会深入解释机制并引用代码路径。

say.text: 我目前能看到哪些提示？为什么？
say.note: 会检查你的设置和提示历史，说明可见性差异。

howto.what_en: Queries the live tip list (`senpi --list-tips`), checks what the user can actually see from settings, verifies the real feature code, then explains in depth in the user's language with file paths.
howto.when_en: When the user says "give-me-tips", asks about a "Tip:" line, or asks how a tipped feature works.

say_en.text: Explain what that Tip: line just shown actually means.
say_en.note: Checks the live tip list and code before answering.

say_en.text: give-me-tips, how does this startup tip's trick work in detail?
say_en.note: Gives a deep, code-verified explanation with paths.

say_en.text: Which tips can I currently see, and why?
say_en.note: Reads your settings and tip history to explain personal visibility.
